transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together to review the launch plan for the new usage-based billing meter. As you know, it's passed sandbox integration tests and we're targeting next month's billing cycle. The current draft has a few key decisions in it -- immediate broad launch, two-decimal half-up rounding, 90 days of raw usage-event retention, and no mandatory invoice-preview review. Before I give final approval, I need to check in with each of you -- billing engineering, finance operations, privacy, and customer support -- to make sure we're not missing anything critical. What are your thoughts and concerns on this plan?
